clue.text: Alarm mostly associated with a black beetle

indicators.note: mostly says the word for alarm loses its final letter

parts.note: an alarm is a scare
B is the standard abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A frightening black beetle is linked with alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: The scarab is a dung beetle, sacred in ancient Egypt.

clue.text: Clever fixing height of waterfall

indicators.note: fixing says the height letter is fixed inside the clever word

parts.note: cute can mean clever or shrewd

explanation.surface: A smart way to fix the height of a waterfall.
explanation.definitionFit: A chute is a waterfall or rapid descent of water in a river.

clue.text: Self-control shown by others surrounding coach

indicators.note: surrounding says the others go around the coach

parts.note: the rest means the others
to coach is to train

explanation.surface: Others gather around a coach, showing composure.
explanation.definitionFit: Restraint is the holding back of oneself, self-control.

clue.text: Full of promise, bowled straight

parts.note: B is the cricket abbreviation for bowled
right can mean straight or direct, as in a right line

explanation.surface: A promising cricketer bowls straight.

clue.text: English crowd fed very good coffee

parts.note: so, as an interjection of approval, can stand for very good in crosswords
to press is to crowd or throng

explanation.surface: An English crowd is served excellent coffee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fed' signals a container: the crowd word is eaten by the word for very good, an approving interjection rather than an adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Espresso is strong black coffee forced through ground beans under steam pressure.

clue.text: How a parcel may be sent, say, before confinement?

definitions.text: How a parcel may be sent

parts.note: to say is to express
confinement is the old term for childbirth, a delivery

explanation.surface: A pregnant woman puts something into words before she gives birth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'before' simply puts one piece ahead of the other.
explanation.definitionFit: Express delivery is a fast postal service for parcels.

clue.text: Studying country's popular head of government

parts.note: Peru is a South American country, with its possessive
in means popular or fashionable

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of the word government

explanation.surface: A country's well-liked head of government.

clue.text: Not included in special edition

definitions.meaning: an additional charge not covered by the basic price
a special issue of a newspaper

explanation.definitionFit: The word means an additional cost and also a special edition of a newspaper.

clue.text: Whisky, for example, taken with good savoury bite to eat

parts.note: Scotch is whisky

explanation.surface: A dram of whisky with a tasty snack.
explanation.walkthrough: A SCOTCH EGG is a British snack: a boiled egg in sausage meat and breadcrumbs.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a savoury snack food, common in British picnics.

clue.text: Damaging allegations by captain bringing fish

parts.note: mud, as in mudslinging, is damaging allegations
a skipper is a ship's or team's captain

explanation.surface: A captain is accused of wrongdoing while bringing in his catch.
explanation.definitionFit: The mudskipper is a goby that hops about on tidal mudflats out of water.

clue.text: Attempt to nick ring in ancient city

parts.note: an attempt is a try
the letter O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: Someone tries to steal a ring in an old city.
explanation.definitionFit: Troy is the ancient city besieged by the Greeks in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Order changed for cashmere? I haven't a clue

indicators.note: order changed means the letters of the word cashmere are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone baffled at a reordering of a cashmere garment pleads ignorance.
explanation.definitionFit: Search me is a colloquial idiom for confessing total ignorance of something.

clue.text: Position of church after good man's article

indicators.note: after says the church comes behind the other pieces in the answer

parts.note: ST, for saint, is a good man
an is the indefinite article
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A saint's writing on the church's stance.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is an attitude or standpoint taken on an issue.

clue.text: Note short skirt

indicators.note: short says the note is cut off before its final letter

parts.note: a minim is a musical note worth two crotchets

explanation.surface: A memo about a brief skirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A mini is a very short skirt, fashionable from the 1960s.

clue.text: Uncomfortable, a guy after trouble

indicators.note: after says the remaining pieces follow the trouble word

parts.note: ill means trouble or harm
to guy is to make fun of, to tease

explanation.surface: A man is ill at ease once trouble comes.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill at ease is an idiom for feeling awkward or uncomfortable.

clue.text: Left in dark

definitions.meaning: Latin for left, still used for the left-hand side of a heraldic shield
dark in the sense of menacing or ominous

explanation.definitionFit: The word means on the left in heraldry and, more generally, threatening or evil.

clue.text: Resent cracks about small bribe

indicators.note: about says the reformed letters go around the small word
cracks says the word resent breaks up and reforms

parts.note: wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: Resentment breaks out over a small bribe.

explanation.definitionFit: A sweetener is an inducement or bribe.

clue.text: Violent tough guys kept in check

indicators.note: kept in says the tough guys are held inside the check

parts.note: to vet is to check
he-men are macho tough guys

explanation.definitionFit: Vehement means forceful and intense, close to violent.

clue.text: Everyone at that place is of normal intelligence

parts.note: all means everyone
there means at that place

explanation.surface: Everybody present seems reasonably bright.
explanation.definitionFit: Being all there is an idiom for being mentally alert and of sound mind.

clue.text: Women excluded from golf club side

parts.note: a wedge is a lofted golf club

clue.text: Cruel, a Parisian child nicking note

indicators.note: nicking means the child steals the note, taking it inside

clue.text: Small article of furniture, durable

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothes labels
a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: A small piece of furniture proves sturdy.

clue.text: Fish, ray, across mouth of river

indicators.note: mouth of picks the first letter of river

explanation.definitionFit: Bream is a freshwater or sea fish.

clue.text: I mention changes very quickly

indicators.note: changes says the letters of I mention are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Someone notes that something alters.

clue.text: Mother with child, one pledging brotherly love?

parts.note: ma is mother
a son is a child

explanation.surface: A mother and child, one of them pledging brotherly love.
explanation.walkthrough: Brotherly love is one of the principles a Freemason pledges; the question mark flags the example.
explanation.definitionFit: A mason is a Freemason, a member of a fraternal order.

clue.text: Club's male champion

parts.note: an ace is an expert or champion

explanation.surface: A men's champion at a sports club.
explanation.definitionFit: A mace is a heavy spiked club used as a medieval weapon.

clue.text: One who watched the start of 'The Sweeney' is upset

the start of picks the first letter of the word The

clue.text: George Martin's first to hear about Earl's arrangement

parts.note: Geo is an old written abbreviation of George

clue.text: Courageous favourite losing length

indicators.note: losing says a letter is dropped from the favourite

parts.note: a darling is a favourite, a pet
